name: How long does it take to replace a cracked patio door glass?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to replace a cracked patio door glass?

acceptedAnswer.text: The actual on-site installation of a new patio door glass pane typically takes a few hours. However, the overall timeline depends on the availability of the specific glass type and size. Custom-cut insulated glass units often require fabrication, which can take several days to a couple of weeks. We strive to expedite the process by ordering quickly and scheduling installation as soon as the new glass is ready, minimizing disruption to your home.
